tagline: Context based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available.
what_it_does: Context based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available. Control which registered VPC endpoints can reach your workspaces, and combine endpoint rules with identity and request type conditions in the same policy. If Context Based Ingress: Workspace Private Access Policies isn't already enabled for your account, an account admin can enable it from the account console Previews page.
why_it_matters: Establish secure, private connections from your AWS VPCs or on premises networks to Databricks services using inbound Private Link, which routes traffic through a VPC interface endpoint instead of the public internet.
plain_summary: Context based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available. Control which registered VPC endpoints can reach your workspaces, and combine endpoint rules with identity and request type conditions in the same policy.
key_takeaway: Context based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available.
